description: A script that regenerates a certificate PEM file by applying substitutions from comments within the file, converting ASCII-encoded DER data to binary, and updating the certificate block in the PEM file.

methods.name: read_file_to_string
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file into a string.

methods.name: write_string_to_file
methods.description: Writes a string to a specified file.

methods.name: replace_string
methods.description: Replaces a specified range within a string with a new string.

methods.name: apply_substitution
methods.description: Finds a section in a template by name and replaces it with a given value.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that processes the PEM file, applies substitutions, converts ASCII to DER, and updates the certificate block.
